messages:
lena-sales: Quick request from EnterpriseBank RFP: Can Redwood run an air-gapped POC with signed incremental patches, no outbound network calls, and a clear rollback path? They also want estimated pricing and cadence.

omar-solutions: Yes. Two signing flows: 1) customer-managed keys (HSM/USB) where they sign manifests; 2) Redwood-signed minibundles with a full attestation packet. Need to confirm whether they prefer delta minibundles or full image swaps.

cristina-eng: We recommend minibundles for POC (delta-friendly, resumable). Bundle contents: chunked tar.gz, bundle.sha256, manifest.json, manifest.sig. Verify offline: `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 && ./verify-manifest --pubkey /opt/keys/enterprise.pub manifest.sig`. No network calls during install.

vikas-security: Security side: we support customer HSM/KMS and documented key-injection/runbook for sneakernet. If they require FIPS-validated HSMs or annual rotation proof, that's an add-on. One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing; key-injection runbook available."

ops-engr: Transfer ops: recommend AES-256 encrypting the minibundle and delivering envelope keys via sealed USB. Use `rsync --partial --inplace` for large transfers; re-run verify after resume. Rollback = re-apply previous signed minibundle; our operator enforces manifest version checks.

omar-solutions: Cadence: propose 4 delta bundles/year (quarterly) + emergency hotfix SLA (48-72h). Pricing roughs: POC eng (10 dev days) ~$30k; offline signed-bundle subscription (4 deltas/yr + priority hotfixes) ~$22k/yr; HSM integration/setup ~$6k one-time.

lena-sales: Legal Q: confirm absolutely no telemetry leaves site during POC and offline updates.

cristina-eng: Confirmed. Offline artifacts have telemetry disabled; only local apply logs are produced and stored on the target.

lena-sales: Great. @artifacts-bot, please open a POC ticket with tags: airgap, customer-hsm, quarterly-patches, sneakernet.

artifacts-bot: POC ticket created: EB-POC-176555 (EnterpriseBank). Assigned to cristina-eng. ETA initial artifact: 5 business days.

lena-sales: Thanks all — I'll add these lines to the RFP response and attach the one-liner and pricing. If procurement wants encrypted bundle workflow details or alternate key delivery, I'll loop in security. :thumbsup:
